question: Select the correct option citing reasons for male migration and their percentages, based on the Census of India 2011.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Education - 2%, marriage - 4%, work employment - 24%.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **45.36 crore Indians (37 percent) **in India are** migrants — now settled in a place different **from their previous residence, new Census 2011 data.
 
• In 2001, the figure** stood at 31.45 crores.**
 
• Migration patterns in India are** increasingly reflecting the economic divide** in the country, with more migrants over the last decade heading to the southern states, which have grown at a faster clip during this period.
 
• With **45.36 Crore migrants in India, every third citizen** of the country is a migrant.
 
• Of these, 69% are women.
 
• Migrants** constitute 37.8% **of India’s 121.03 Crore population. Over the last decade, the total number of migrants in India rose by 44.35 percent from 31.45 Crore in 2001. During the same period, India’s **population grew by 17.64%.**
